vehicles.name: Sedan
vehicles.description: Room for four passengers plus two suitcases, this is the go-to pick for a quick airport drop or a tidy business run around town. Cool AC, a good music system, and a driver who knows the routes keep every trip smooth.

vehicles.name: SUV
vehicles.description: Six seats with a third row that folds away when you need the boot, making this the practical choice for a family holiday or a trip with friends. Strong engines and chilled interiors take the edge off long highways.

vehicles.name: Tempo Traveller
vehicles.description: Built for big parties, our 12 to 26-seater coaches come with reclining push-back seats, screens for entertainment, and plenty of room for everyone's bags. A dependable choice for office outings, religious tours, and wedding functions.

vehicles.name: Luxury Car
vehicles.description: Premium machines like the Fortuner and BMW 5 Series with leather seating, onboard Wi-Fi, and bottled water waiting in the cabin. Ideal when you want to make a statement at a meeting, an airport pickup, or a milestone celebration.

vehicles.name: Wedding Cars
vehicles.description: Flower-adorned cars and vintage classics dressed up for the baraat, vidaai, and every function in between. A chauffeur in uniform, a red-carpet welcome, and decor that matches the theme of your celebration.

services.name: Local Taxi
services.description: Hire a cab by the hour and cover the whole city at your own pace — market runs, temple visits, school pickups, or errands across town. Fixed-hour packages keep the billing simple and predictable.

services.name: Outstation Cab
services.description: Head to another city for work, a family visit, or a hill-station break without worrying about who drives. Clean cars and steady drivers make multi-hundred-kilometre journeys feel effortless.

services.name: One-Way Taxi
services.description: A point-to-point ride that charges only for the distance you travel — no return fare, no empty-drive charges. The leanest option when you plan to fly or train back on your own.

services.name: Round Trip
services.description: Keep the same cab and driver for the whole itinerary, with night-halt allowances sorted so nobody hunts for parking or a room. A clean fit for multi-day tours where plans change along the way.

services.name: Airport Transfer
services.description: Arrive to a waiting car and a driver who has tracked your flight's status, so a delayed landing never means a missed pickup. Door-to-door service at any hour, with early-morning departures handled too.

services.name: Wedding Car Rental
services.description: Dressed-up cars for the baraat, the vidaai, and every function in between, with flower and ribbon decor arranged to your liking. The fleet and chauffeurs stick to your event schedule from start to finish.

services.name: Corporate Car Rental
services.description: Transport for your staff, visiting clients, and offsite events handled by chauffeurs in formal attire. Monthly billing and dedicated vehicles make it simple for teams that are on the road most days.
